propositions: The codebase has 64 active ARG violations (unused parameters) that require one-off remediation through mechanical fixes and targeted decisions across six classification buckets
Cluster-1 reconciler leaf handlers (10 violations) should be normalized to accept **_kwargs to safely remove unused parameters without breaking runtime dispatch via string introspection
Cluster-2 OutboundMapper Protocol implementations (7 violations) have parameters pinned by keyword call sites and Protocol structural contracts, making renames unsafe
Three real accepted-then-dropped defects are excluded from this sweep and left in place: timeout_s, close_reason, and acli_cmd bug
ARG will not be permanently enabled in pyproject.toml; a gate decision should be revisited after measuring the irreducible exception count post-sweep
